data-testid="rich-text"><div class="ssrcss-nqezkk-RichTextContainer e5tfeyi1"><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10"><b>Eom Jisung's excellent start to the 2026-27 season reached another level after he scored the winning goal as South Korea clinched the Asian Games football title.</b></p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The Swansea winger scored the only goal as South Korea beat hosts Japan 1-0 in Aichi to win their fourth successive Asian Games crown.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Eom, who starred for Championship leaders Swansea before international duty, scored four goals and notched three assists during the competition.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">His impressive Asian Games campaign included an opening game hat-trick against Qatar and a composed finish to seal victory in the final.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Eom finishes as the tournament's joint-top goalscorer alongside Uzbekistan's Sardorbek Bakhromov.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">By becoming an Asian Games champion, the 24-year-old has secured an exemption from mandatory service in South Korea's military.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Able-bodied South Korean males are typically required to undertake between 18 and 21 months of military service before turning 28.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">However, the government rewards Asian Games champions and Olympic medallists with a service exemption, bar basic training which lasts less than a month.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Eom featured for his country at the World Cup over the summer and was selected as one of three over-age players for this competition.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Swansea return to Championship action when they host Norwich City in an early kick-off on Saturday, 10 October. </p></div></div></div></div><div
